rounded_display.qualification: Numerical estimator with estimated sampling SE; this diagnostic does not establish numerical convergence.

graph_variance_diagnostics.note: Per-graph diagonal variance estimates omit empirical cross-graph covariances and therefore do not exactly partition the reported group-replicate variance. A projected mean is a local C8 sensitivity; it is not an additive decomposition of the complete nonlinear coefficient.

bootstrap.note: Conditional replicate bootstrap; with R observations a linear empirical bootstrap variance has factor (R-1)/R relative to the unbiased covariance estimate. It cannot detect regions missed by all observations.

replicate_half_diagnostic.note: The first and second halves partition randomized replicate indices, with fixed points per graph-replicate. This is not a within-stream point split or a doubled-point convergence test.

assembly_rounding_check.note: Reassembles the same sampled mean jets and high-precision analytic two-loop input; this checks final assembly arithmetic only.

scope: Complete graph coverage supplies an estimator. Small randomized-replicate counts and small high-loop point counts do not establish integration convergence, a rigorous error bound, or field-theory validity.
